description: April 27 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 27 birthday falls in Taurus, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of an April 27 birthday
paragraphs: On April 27 the Sun is around seven degrees into Taurus and the birthday number is 9, linked with compassion and completion. Venus colours both sign and decan. The combination is often described as generous groundedness: someone who shares what they have built, gives practical help freely and values kindness above display.

By noon UTC on April 27, the Sun has normally reached roughly 7° of Taurus. That places the date in the Taurus decan that astrologers give to Venus, the first of three. With Venus as both ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan of Taurus is traditionally seen as the sign at its most sensuous and steady. Birthdays from about April 20 to April 30 land here. The emphasis is on comfort that has been earned: texture, taste, music and the slow pleasure of things done well. This doubled Venus tone is often linked with loyalty and a calm, grounding presence that friends lean on. It can also make change feel like an imposition rather than an invitation. Those born in this decan tend to flourish when they treat flexibility as another form of care, not a threat to it.

sections.heading: Numerology of the April 27 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same April 27 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: April 27 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 27 is the 117th day of the year (118th in a leap year). In most years Gemini season is under way by May 21, 24 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 27 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. April 27 is also the birthday of Ulysses S. Grant (1822), Mary Wollstonecraft (1759) and William Alexander of the Netherlands (1967).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 27?
faq.answer: April 27 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 27 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 27?
faq.answer: By April 27 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 27?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an April 27 birthday are Ulysses S. Grant (1822), Mary Wollstonecraft (1759) and William Alexander of the Netherlands (1967). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
